Il pattern UIP alla TC (linee guida ATS/:
The UIP pattern on CT (ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 2022 guidelines) is defined by honeycombing (with or without traction bronchiectasis) with basal and subpleural predominance, often heterogeneous. With a typical picture and a compatible clinical context, the diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis can be made without biopsy, after multidisciplinary discussion and exclusion of other causes (connective tissue diseases, drugs, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, occupational exposures).
Honeycombing and emphysema are easily confused: honeycombing has walled cysts, in several rows beneath the pleura, at the bases; centrilobular emphysema has wall-less spaces, predominant in the upper lobes.
Honeycombing subpleurico basale + bronch: Basal subpleural honeycombing + traction bronchiectasis = UIP pattern.
Nessuna diagnosi clinica nei dati della: No clinical diagnosis in the LIDC-IDRI collection data (which concerns nodules: no nodules marked by the 4 radiologists). The UIP pattern is a reading of the images, not confirmed by histology or multidisciplinary discussion.
